Command: Do not follow the thoughts of your heart or the sight of your eyes into idolatry
Summary: Numbers 15:39 joins the fringe to its warning: Israel was not to seek after its own heart and its own eyes, after which it used to go a whoring. The wandering heart and eye are the road to idolatry.
Commandment: Do not follow the thoughts of your heart or the sight of your eyes into idolatry.
Application: The fringe reminded; the warning endures without the fringe. Hearts and eyes still lead astray, and God's word still answers them.
Purpose: Scripture's stated reason: that ye may look upon the fringe and remember all the commandments of the LORD and do them, and not follow your own heart and eyes (Numbers 15:39).
